summary: Backend-only tests for file uploads and account linking bug fix. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_uploads_and_perms.py with 15 tests: image/video/pdf upload, uploader_id/name linkage, public download, list+filter, delete removes DB+disk, social media_url preservation, chat file_url preservation, dashboard revenue visibility for CEO vs Marketing, and mail permission (403 for Employee, allowed for CEO/HR Manager/Marketing Manager). All 15 tests PASS.

minor.issue: Request spec says max 100MB, code enforces 50MB (server_ext.py:317). Not breaking any test but tighten to match spec.

action_items: Optional: raise upload cap from 50MB to 100MB in server_ext.py upload_file to match spec.
Note: /api/auth/register does not exist; new users must be created via /api/os/employees (CEO required).
critical_code_review_comments: server_ext.py upload_file cap is 50MB — inconsistent with the 100MB spec in the review request.
server_ext.py list_attendance uses a suspicious expression `[{**d, '_id': None} and {k:v ...}]` which relies on truthy-and-return; works but is confusing.

Mail permission logic in server_realtime.py depends on user['role']/roles which is fine, but a Marketing (single-role) user gets 403 while Marketing Manager gets 200 — verify this is intended (it is per spec).
server.py dashboard_summary always returns revenue_today=0 for CEO (hardcoded), which is placeholder logic, not real revenue calc.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed employees (Marketing, Employee, HR Manager, Marketing Manager) via /api/os/employees; uploaded PNG/MP4/PDF files remain in DB and /app/backend/uploads. Consider periodic cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login returns access_token (not token). No /api/auth/register — create users via CEO POST /api/os/employees with {email,password,name,role}. Then PATCH /api/os/employees/{id}/roles to sync multi-role perms. pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2; use -n 0 for serial runs when using pytest attr sharing.
rca of the issue: The original bug 'الحسابات غير مربوطه' (accounts not linked) is verified fixed: /api/os/files/upload persists uploader_id and uploader_name from the JWT-authenticated user, list_files returns those fields, and social/chat endpoints preserve media_url/file_url pointing to /api/files/download/{fname}. Public download works without auth via FileResponse. All uploads and links validated end-to-end.
